basic_profile.bio: Aspiring screenwriter and science fiction enthusiast based in Portland, Oregon. I'm fascinated by the evolution of storytelling, particularly in the realm of superheroes and villains. I spend my days working as a freelance writer, crafting narratives for indie video games and short films. Outside of work, I enjoy hiking in the Pacific Northwest and am an avid collector of vintage comic books. Typically online during late evenings, where I unwind by diving into discussions on storytelling tropes and character development. Recently single, navigating the dating world with a sense of humor.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: A deep-seated passion for storytelling and science fiction, cultivated through a degree in Creative Writing and countless hours of consuming media. My knowledge is a mix of formal education and self-teaching, particularly in the fields of narrative structure and speculative fiction.
